reviews_list.review_title: Very good in academics and ayurvedic treatment.

review_content.Placements: 40 percent of students placed in my course. The highest package should be 2 Lacs the lowest is 25000 and the average is 75000. 90% of students got internships. Ayurveda is very good for treatment and practice purposes and has many scopes. The kayachikitsa and panchkarma are top roles offered in college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure, classroom, and library are very good. The food available in the canteen is good quality, nice medical facility and sports games like football, cricket and days. The hostel is very good with clean toilets and ventilated rooms, a nice gym, and a campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Really a good college with fabulous teaching facilities buult need to work on hostel facility .

review_content.Placements: The medical field does not work like the engineering field. So here, companies do not come for placement; instead, we, as doctors, have to go to the hospital to find a job. The student with more practical knowledge will be selected by that particular hospital on the basis of your interview with the head of that particular hospital.
review_content.Infrastructure: At my arrival at the college, the hostel was already full, so you can judge from the basics of this information that the hostel was good enough for the students to live their college lives. The whole campus was environment-friendly, with a play group large enough to hold sports events every year.

reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best ayurvedic college in Mumbai.

review_content.Placements: We didn't have any placement options here as this is a medical college, so the placements don't work here much. Once or twice, we had the seminars, but they were not that beneficial. For placements, you cannot rely on this college. You can not deny any other medical college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well ventilated, clean, and hygienic but don't have air-conditioners. It is not much required as the environment inside the campus and the hospital building is good. The library is well stocked with many books, and the labs are also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: The facilities provided by the college is quite average.

review_content.Placements: Our college doesn't give us placements but students themselves have to search for a job No package courses are offered to medical student. One should try to apply for a job at the best hospitals in city. Every student gets internship as it is compulsory for every student. Ayurvedic medicine study as well as allopathic medicine study.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classroom, library, washroom, labs, opd, ipd. The quality of food isn't that good. The canteen should update their menu as well as serve hygienic food and full of nutrition. The sports and games faculty isn't that bad, nss camps need to be improved for the students.

reviews_list.review_title: Very good placement all over Karnataka.

review_content.Placements: There is 100% placement in B.A.M.S., UG, and PG courses offered at a high of 1 crore, the lowest at 4 lakh per annum. The Himayala company offers senior president doctor positions in government hospitals. After completing a 5-year study internship, they will offer around 25 thousand, and for a PG, they will offer 38 thousand.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available, but not for 1st year students. The library is mandatory for every book in Ayurveda, and both modern and traditional are there in the library hostel. Food is good and healthy; high-calorie food is provided, and government scholarships are also provided by the state government.

reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2021

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Comprehensive review of Saraswati Medical College: facilities, education, and internships.

review_content.Placements: My college doesn't provide any placements because it's a medical college. This college provides courses for MBBS and nursing. It gives internship opportunities for at least 6 months. During this time period, students learn how to treat people and give them a good life.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is average because many buildings are still under construction and do not have proper functioning at all. Hostel is good for two people in a single room, but the mess food is average. It doesn't have free wi-fi. The hygiene of the hostel is also not good compared to other private medical colleges.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Saraswati medical College.

review_content.Placements: Placements are good but depend on marks and knowledge. Hospital across India is in Lacs. Around 100 students got internships and doing our college. The roles offered are mainly juniors and interns. Our college gives Rs.10,000 for internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: College has some facilities and lacks many facilities such as a gym, pool, etc. College provides a library, labs, and sports ground for outdoor and indoor games. The campus is very neat and green. Environment is good. It is on the highway so easy to transport.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied with this college because I expected everything to be good.

review_content.Placements: Currently, they are all in internships and will be completing their internships in June 2022. Almost everybody is doing internships except a few who will be clearing their final exams. In the 2019 batch, it has not been a good start. Almost 50% of our batchmates have failed to clear the first year. Our previous senior of 2017 batch is also in not good shape, and many have failed their 2nd year and 3rd year of their medical exams.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are 3-LT i.e lecture halls. Almost all of them have air-conditioners. Projectors are available to teach the students with the help of presentations. White boards are available to make students understand something. Hostel food is average and can be improved. There are 2 messes for students to eat. Hostel rooms are for double accommodation.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: It's worth it. It is full of joy, happiness and peace.

review_content.Placements: In medical colleges, the placements are always good. It's tough to complete your MBBS, but once you come out of this, there are numerous opportunities and placements according to your knowledge. It gave me an opportunity to meet different people and learn many things. I have received great support from faculty members and the placement office. I am thankful to the training and placement cell for providing a platform to enhance my skills and giving me an opportunity to showcase them.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is well-equipped with all the necessary equipment and facilities, including libraries, Wi-Fi, sports centres and laboratories. The college has even some classrooms equipped with air-conditioners. The canteen food is not very tasty, but it's not that bad too.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Saraswati Medical College, Unnao.

review_content.Placements: In our college, the first batch was started in 2016, and we will know the placement percentage this year. We are in the hope of getting a good percentage. They now got their internships, and we look forward to a good placement rate.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good with almost all the facilities required. Medical facilities are available as it is a medical college itself. We are provided with good quality food in our mess, and we have 2 different mess facilities. The infrastructure is developing day by day as the college is in its development phase.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: There are very nice faculty members here. It is a good college to become a doctor.

review_content.Placements: Our college offers an MBBS course, and there are a great number of patients here. We get to learn many things here. Internships are offered by our college only.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite good here. There are different departments for every subject and labs related to it. Our college has a museum and a mortuary, and there is a total of 4 lecture theatres. The library and reading room are also available here where we can find every book we need. Wi-Fi facility is available. The food served in the hostel is very nice, and hostel rooms are also huge with attached washrooms. Canteens and hospital services are available. There is a sports and indoor games room in the hostel. Our college provides food and lodging facilities to every student, faculty member, SRs, JRs and other nursing staff members.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Comprehensive review of Saraswati Medical College: facilities, education, and internships.

content.Placements: My college doesn't provide any placements because it's a medical college. This college provides courses for MBBS and nursing. It gives internship opportunities for at least 6 months. During this time period, students learn how to treat people and give them a good life.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is average because many buildings are still under construction and do not have proper functioning at all. Hostel is good for two people in a single room, but the mess food is average. It doesn't have free wi-fi. The hygiene of the hostel is also not good compared to other private medical colleges.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Saraswati medical College.

content.Placements: Placements are good but depend on marks and knowledge. Hospital across India is in Lacs. Around 100 students got internships and doing our college. The roles offered are mainly juniors and interns. Our college gives Rs.10,000 for internships.
content.Infrastructure: College has some facilities and lacks many facilities such as a gym, pool, etc. College provides a library, labs, and sports ground for outdoor and indoor games. The campus is very neat and green. Environment is good. It is on the highway so easy to transport.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with this college because I expected everything to be good.

content.Placements: Currently, they are all in internships and will be completing their internships in June 2022. Almost everybody is doing internships except a few who will be clearing their final exams. In the 2019 batch, it has not been a good start. Almost 50% of our batchmates have failed to clear the first year. Our previous senior of 2017 batch is also in not good shape, and many have failed their 2nd year and 3rd year of their medical exams.
content.Infrastructure: There are 3-LT i.e lecture halls. Almost all of them have air-conditioners. Projectors are available to teach the students with the help of presentations. White boards are available to make students understand something. Hostel food is average and can be improved. There are 2 messes for students to eat. Hostel rooms are for double accommodation.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It's worth it. It is full of joy, happiness and peace.

content.Placements: In medical colleges, the placements are always good. It's tough to complete your MBBS, but once you come out of this, there are numerous opportunities and placements according to your knowledge. It gave me an opportunity to meet different people and learn many things. I have received great support from faculty members and the placement office. I am thankful to the training and placement cell for providing a platform to enhance my skills and giving me an opportunity to showcase them.
content.Infrastructure: The college is well-equipped with all the necessary equipment and facilities, including libraries, Wi-Fi, sports centres and laboratories. The college has even some classrooms equipped with air-conditioners. The canteen food is not very tasty, but it's not that bad too.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Review of Saraswati Medical College, Unnao.

content.Placements: In our college, the first batch was started in 2016, and we will know the placement percentage this year. We are in the hope of getting a good percentage. They now got their internships, and we look forward to a good placement rate.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good with almost all the facilities required. Medical facilities are available as it is a medical college itself. We are provided with good quality food in our mess, and we have 2 different mess facilities. The infrastructure is developing day by day as the college is in its development phase.

Infrastructure is so good. There is good environment. 
The big library is there.

individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities, and it is the 4th top medical college in Tamil Nadu.

content.Placements: Each batch has 100 students. The college is established in 2015 and is a government medical college. The total course duration is 5 and 1/2 years. You get the degree certificate after completing the course and officially become a doctor. You have to prepare for NEET PG for further higher studies.

There is a ground available for volleyball, football, and basketball.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied, and I recommend this college for admission.

content.Placements: At first, there were 100 students in our course. The salary offered depends on the experience, and it can vary from Rs. 30,000 to 2 lacs per month, so the experience is very important. Every year around 50% of the students got an internship. Students are also pursuing higher education in good universities.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a good infrastructure with Wi-Fi facilities with full signals. Labs are well-ventilated with an air cooler and a large surface area. Classrooms are large, like lecture theatre with air-conditioners. It has smartboard facilities with computers and a mick system. Hostel rooms are good with a study table and a good bed. Sports day is celebrated every year with all games like basketball, football, volleyball and kabaddi and with all the indoor games too.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is one of the best dental colleges in Ghaziabad.

content.Placements: Almost all the graduate students are qualified in their work. The pay scale was uniform for all, which was approximately Rs. 50,000 to 2 Lacs per month. For the undergraduate students, one year of rotational internship is compulsory in the college itself.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a newly renovated library with a vast collection of books and journals. The hostel is nearby, and the building is relatively new. The only downside is the ratio of the number of rooms to students, which leads to 2-3 sharing basis.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: Mainly this college doesn't provide any placement outside the college but the academics and infrastructure are good for a dental student. There is only an academic. No placement facility is available in this dental college and internship is done in this college only.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is okay. The hostel is good a student can live there easily and study properly. Lecture halls are available in our college. Labs are well-furnished. The clinical department is also cleaned and sanitized. There is no risk of any infection or hospital-acquired infection.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: There's a cons and pros in every college but study wise a good college .

content.Placements: 100 in every batch so there are 500 students in BDS and 23-27 in MS. Placements are not that much since it's a private college. Internship are done in our college only since it's a college+ hospital. Research work also done in our college and grants are also given by icmr.
content.Infrastructure: There's are many facilities like library canteen with sitting area. Wi-Fi labs are also good, departments are properly function. AC in lecture halls. Food quality is good in mess and canteen but there are many paced food also. Sports are also there but due to patient quota we don't have the time to play them.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The faculty and the college infrastructure are really good.

content.Placements: The placements in this college aren't good. No placement packages are offered in this college and no companies come here for recruitment. All the students get internship opportunities in the college itself.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities in this college are great with a nice infrastructure and location. All the labs and classes are well maintained and clean. We've an access to all the required books available in the library and Wi-Fi connection is also provided. Food quality is nice in the hostel. Medical facilities are provided as well.
content.Faculty: Teachers are really good and they put in their best efforts. They make the students well prepared for any sort of situation regarding their work. Semester exams are tough. Students have to put in a lot of efforts and the teachers make us well prepared for the final exams held by the university.

review_summary.college_name: Poornima University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. CSE (Full stack Development and Mobile Applications) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Modern campus, good learning.

content.Placements: At Poornima University, placement opportunities vary by branch and individual performance. Generally, around 80 to 90 percent of students in popular branches like Computer Science and it get placed. The real placement numbers are very high for this college.
content.Infrastructure: My university offers modern infrastructure with well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, libraries, and sports facilities. It provides multiple courses like B.Tech, MBA, BVA, BBA, and design, along with a comfortable hostel featuring Wi-Fi, mess, sports, and many gardens.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.

content.Placements: The total number of students in B.Tech CSE is almost 1500. So a minimum of 100 to 120 students is selected. The highest package is 23 Lacs, the average package is 6-7 Lacs, and the lowest package is 2-3 Lacs. The above details are based on campus placement records. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and HCL Technologies. In our college, internships start from the 6th semester, and mainly they are with local companies based in Jaipur. Almost 20 to 30% of students get internships, mainly for data analyst positions.
content.Infrastructure: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 students eating at a time. In a day, meals are served four times. Hostel life is very good on campus with free Wi-Fi, laundry, sports coaches, a gym, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure facilities not satisfied with placements.

content.Placements: In my course 20 percent of students placed this year 2025. The highest package offered is 7LPA, the lowest package is 3.5LPA and the average package is 4LPA. Top recruiters are Fingertips, cellular technologies, and Robo MQ. 30 percent get internships. The Data Engineer roles course is very excellent but not for average students studywise.
content.Infrastructure: The university provides Wi-Fi in each and every PC. Labs are excellent with AC and projectors. Classrooms are also very nice. Infrastructure is excellent. Food in hostel is average or above average we can say. Canteen is also there, sports facility is also available.

individual_reviews.course: MCA in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Poornima University: Best college for placements and learning.

content.Placements: College provides lots of placement opportunities. In the year, lots of companies visit for campus drives. There is approximately a 50-60% placement percentage. The lowest packages depend on the company, they vary from 2.5 to 3.5 LPA, and the highest packages go up to 12-15 LPA. Many good companies come for placement, like Infosys, Josh, Datansh, Metacube, TCS, Dotsquare, and CIMET.
content.Infrastructure: The campus covers 32 acres and features cutting-edge ICT-enabled classrooms with Wi-Fi, LAN, and projectors. Seminar halls, auditoriums, and multimedia-equipped lecture rooms support conferences, workshops, and cultural events. The central library offers over 2400 volumes, a wide range of journals, and access to IEEE, DELNET, and other digital resources for engineering, management, architecture, and IT programs. Hostels are located on campus with secure access, providing accommodation for both boys and girls, including Himalaya Boys and Gargi Girls hostels. Hostel messes serve four daily meals under hygienic standards, alongside canteens offering vegetarian snacks.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It's all good and the best.

content.Placements: 60 to 80 per cent of students were placed most of the time in our college. The highest package is 30 LPA. The lowest is approximately 5.5. content.Infrastructure: All good, but need to be better, and one thing which I also notice is that it's improving day by day. The management also saw that they needed to improve, so they implemented the procedure, and they are trying their best, but the quality in the hostel is, although good.

reviews.review_heading: Modern campus, good learning.
reviews.review_text: My university offers modern infrastructure with well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, libraries, and sports facilities. It provides multiple courses like B.Tech, MBA, BVA, BBA, and design, along with a comfortable hostel featuring Wi-Fi, mess, sports, and many gardens.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.
reviews.review_text: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 student...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure facilities not satisfied with placements.
reviews.review_text: The university provides Wi-Fi in each and every PC. Labs are excellent with AC and projectors. Classrooms are also very nice. Infrastructure is excellent. Food in hostel is average or above average we can say. Canteen is also there, sports facility is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Poornima University: Best college for placements and learning.
reviews.review_text: The campus covers 32 acres and features cutting-edge ICT-enabled classrooms with Wi-Fi, LAN, and projectors. Seminar halls, auditoriums, and multimedia-equipped lecture rooms support conferences, workshops, and cultural events. The central library offers over 2400 volumes, a wide range of journals, and access to IEEE, DELNET, and other digital resources for engineering, management, architecture, and IT programs. Hostels are located on campus with secure access, providing accommodation for both b...

reviews.review_heading: It's all good and the best.
reviews.review_text: All good, but need to be better, and one thing which I also notice is that it's improving day by day. The management also saw that they needed to improve, so they implemented the procedure, and they are trying their best, but the quality in the hostel is, although good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, and good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are very good for my course. We have Wi-Fi connections, computer labs with good working systems, and a library with many reference and other books. The facilities in the hostel are good. As I am not from the hostel, I have heard from my friends that the food quality, sports and games, and medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and supportive faculty, with vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course at Poornima University is quite modern, with a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, well-equipped computer labs, digital classrooms, and a central library that provides access to both books and e-resources. The hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and 24/7 security.

reviews.review_heading: Good for the economic family.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is available here; sometimes you find it sufficient, sometimes not. Almost, they have all the things that you want, not so, but so. They have a gym, football ground, American football ground, and central park; it's like a semi-event area, and currently, they are expanding their campus and infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The college is average and not worth as per the fee it charges.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities require significant improvement. Washrooms are hygienic and poorly maintained, which affects daily comfort and sanitation. Additionally, the Wi-Fi connectivity is unreliable, disrupting online activities and communication. The quality of food provided is also subpar and lacks consistency in taste and nutrition. Overall, these issues impact the living experience and need immediate attention.

reviews.review_heading: Poornima University - Just another tier 3 college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. AC computer labs are assigned in place of traditional lecture halls. Every student has their own assigned PC. Talking about mess, food is satisfactory and quality and hygiene are maintained well. Sports exposure is great too, regular trials are conducted for university teams. Campus has courts for sports like tennis, pickleball, football, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the environment and fests. Infrastructure development is a little annoying.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good, but the food in the mess is below average. However, overall it can be taken. I can't comment on hygiene, as the food is prepared elsewhere and then brought to the college. The classrooms are good, and the big library is pretty good.

reviews.review_heading: I opted for this college because of good and helpful faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Everything is perfect; the lab is well-equipped, with excellent air conditioning. The teachers are good, and the hostel is satisfactory, though the student population is a concern. All sports are available, such as cricket, tennis, basketball, etc., and I am happy to recommend them.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with my college as it has good faculty members and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is good. Labs are too good with AC, and the new block and open stage stadium are being created.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with infrastructure and faculty. Great learning, average placements, and fun events.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are best for girls, especially since rooms are highly maintained. The washrooms are super clean. However, the boys' hostel is not the same as the girls, their washrooms are not in healthy condition. The mess food is average. The medical facilities are the best. They provide sports activities in the evening, which are open to hostellers and day scholars.

reviews.review_heading: Best private college within budget with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: There is a dedicated computer lab for the whole day for B.Tech, BCA, and MCA students. Classrooms are pretty decent, and the academic block is nice. There is a need for improvement in hostel food and infrastructure. There is serious development and construction ongoing to make a new academic building and hostel.
